citations.title: KRYSTAL-1: Phase 1/2 Adagrasib in KRAS G12C-Mutated NSCLC
citations.span: Asclepius positions adagrasib as a retrospective backtest with a data cutoff of 2022-06-01 (Jänne et al. NEJM publication). All facts in this snapshot are constrained to that cutoff so the framework's PoS chain and ML prior can be re-applied as they would have been pre-readout, before BMS's $4.8B October 2023 acquisition announcement.

Mirati Therapeutics Q1 2022 Financial Results and Business Highlights
citations.span: Mirati Therapeutics is a single-asset-concentrated clinical-stage oncology company; adagrasib is the lead program. The sponsor at the methodology's June 2022 data cutoff is the standalone Mirati entity — BMS's acquisition announcement does not occur until October 2023 and closes January 2024, both well after the backtest cutoff.

citations.title: Adagrasib in Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Harboring a KRASG12C Mutation
citations.span: Among 116 patients with NSCLC and a KRAS G12C mutation who had previously been treated with platinum-based chemotherapy and anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy, 42.9% had a confirmed objective response. As of the June 2022 cutoff used in this snapshot, adagrasib is in Phase 2 registrational development — the FDA accelerated approval did not arrive until December 2022.

citations.title: Mirati Receives FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for Adagrasib in KRAS G12C-Mutated NSCLC
citations.span: FDA granted breakthrough therapy designation to adagrasib in June 2021 for patients with KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC. Fast-track and orphan-drug designations were granted at earlier points; the diligence record encodes the headline BTD as the load-bearing regulatory signal. (Accelerated-approval status is excluded because it post-dates the June 2022 cutoff.)

citations.title: Mirati Therapeutics Q1 2022 Financial Results and Business Highlights
citations.span: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments of approximately $899.5M as of March 31, 2022. Methodology classifies this as the 'adequate' tier (multi-quarter runway with demonstrated capital-markets access pre-readout). The reflexivity-thesis writeup notes a defensible case for the 'constrained' tier given single-asset concentration; default is adequate to match the canonical ADAGRASIB record.
